args.sql:
CREATE TABLE audit_mechanism (
    encounter_id VARCHAR(30),
    patient_id VARCHAR(20),
    timestamp TIMESTAMP,
    reason TEXT
);

INSERT INTO audit_mechanism (encounter_id, patient_id, timestamp, reason)
SELECT 
    e.enckey AS encounter_id,
    e.patref AS patient_id,
    e.timemark AS timestamp,
    'High suicide risk and high violence risk' AS reason
FROM 
    encounters AS e
JOIN 
    assessmentbasics AS ab ON e.abref = ab.abkey
JOIN 
    assessmentsymptomsandrisk AS asr ON ab.abkey = asr.asrkey
WHERE 
    asr.suicrisk = 'High'
    AND asr.violrisk = 'High';
